name: preserve-project-intent
description: Keeps long-running projects aligned to their mission across blockers, gates, reviews, and session handoffs.

interface.shortDescription: Keep long projects on mission across blockers and handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Separates mission, milestone, active task, blocker, and return point; controls nested scope expansion; and creates or consumes canonical cross-session handoffs without mistaking local completion for project completion.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Preserve Project Intent to fix the mission, current milestone, completion boundary, and return point before continuing this project.
